title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, compiles context and work, lets identical workers self-assign safe opportunities, verifies actual mechanism use, integrates evidence under explicit authority, self-critiques route quality and recursively generates useful next waves with decreasing human coordination.
human_goal: The human normally uses `/g` in any fresh chat to recover the guide, sends `.` to execute the current durable frontier, and only when actual unclaimed demand exists opens N identical `/wc` workers. No old-chat dependency, numbered routing, result transport, durable memory burden, manual batch design or critic-of-last-resort role.
success_conditions: Fresh guide reincarnation without transcript or old-chat lookup.
Dot executes from durable state and persists changed frontier.
Executable Planner compiler generates N+1 from durable returns/dispositions and later N+2 through the same path without human task wording.
Identical workers atomically claim distinct work and expose auditable lifecycle/context/write evidence.
Generic stale/retry/supersession prevents vanished chats from gating progress.
Context Fabric Lite compiles small role/task Working Sets with source-linked receipts and hard authority/privacy/freshness constraints.
Steward/Validator reconcile evidence while Human Accepted/Current/Served remain distinct.
Fresh critics trigger from evidence/risk and can change/falsify routes.
At least two automatic worker generations complete and useful durable results per human intervention improves.
Prometeo/Facultad/Alumnos operate as durable concurrent roots.
Parent can disappear mid-loop and a successor continues.
current_frontier: Seven material acceleration returns were consumed incrementally while the metrics worker remains active. Fresh strategic criticism moved the gate from 'have a Planner design' to an executable metabolic spine. GEN-PROMETEO-ACCEL-02 was compiled from durable worker evidence and explicit parent/steward dispositions, without human task-by-task design. Q-GENERATED-GEN2-01 exposes five READY implementation tasks: Planner compiler, typed integration ingress, Context Fabric Lite P1, non-deployed metabolism tick candidate, and canary evidence hardening. Two higher-order gates remain dependency-blocked: the live N+1->N+2 canary and its fresh independent compounding verifier. Production /w remains gated.
next_human_action: Derive from exact current generated-queue claims. If READY generated items remain unclaimed after refresh, open only that many fresh chats with the identical `/wc` command. Otherwise send no worker-launch instruction.
authority_law: This Chat Object may orchestrate and consume candidate evidence within its scope. Generated queues and worker/critic returns do not self-promote. Human Accepted, Current, Catalog, Lineage and Served remain separate owner-controlled authorities.
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, roots, generation inputs/outputs, queues/claims/runs/returns, integration, verification or frontier must be durable before relying on conversation memory.
